name: Good Hope, Lesser
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [emotion, hope, mind-affecting]; Level bard 1, mesmerist 1
Duration 1 round/level

DESCRIPTION

This spell acts as the spell good hope except as noted above and grants a +1 morale bonus on saving throws, attack rolls, ability checks, skill checks, and weapon damage rolls.
